about_the_game:
Step into the cozy world of Hidden Cats by Louisselle 🐾 — a hidden object game set within the pages of artist Louisselle’s own sketchbook.

On each page, you’ll find a grayscale pixel art illustration 🎨. As you discover hidden cats, the image gradually fills with color and reveals new details 🌈. Selecting one of these artworks takes you to its corresponding scene, where many cats are quietly waiting to be found 🐱.

Relax with gentle, soothing music 🎧, carefully composed to create a sense of calm and well-being as you explore every corner of these lovingly crafted illustrations. There’s no time limit, no pressure — just you, the art, and plenty of charming cats.

Whether you're looking to unwind, take a break, or simply enjoy beautiful pixel art, Hidden Cats by Louisselle offers a peaceful experience with a generous touch of cuteness 💗.

Features:

  • 🎨 Pixel art environments by Louisselle

  • 🐱 Cats, cats, and more cats

  • 🎶 A calm and immersive soundtrack

  • ⏳ Play at your own pace
